_doc: Craters as the player makes them (Prender-272 marks as decals; Psimulation-106 a blow on a street is a street's blow): a blow of force 10 on the street at the corner (60, 8) ({at: [x, z]}, the deck the click lands on; setView's y is the map's north, -z, so it stands at setView (60, -8)), its crater in the paving with cracks, the road cut, the kerb's face and the buildings round it left; then a blow of force 20 on bare earth outside the town (900, 900), its pit. Each near (20 px a metre) from 45 degrees at four azimuths for the street, at street level (10), from above (85), and mid (8) for the earth.
